mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_event_invitation (event_id, tenant_id, invitation_url, oob_id) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{tenantId}, #{invitationUrl}, #{oobId})
mapper.select: SELECT event_invitation_id, event_id, tenant_id, invitation_url, oob_id, is_valid, created_at, updated_at FROM tb_event_invitation WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND is_valid = true

SELECT event_invitation_id, event_id, tenant_id, invitation_url, oob_id, is_valid, created_at, updated_at FROM tb_event_invitation WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND is_valid = true ORDER BY created_at DESC
